_comment: Entities (persons, events) that share a name with a story-relevant entity but are NOT part of the story being collected. Pages primarily about these entities are skipped during crawl/extraction, and their links are not followed. The entity nodes are still recorded in the graph with out_of_scope=true metadata so they are visible as disambiguation markers but never expanded. Add entries here — no code changes required.
